title.zh: Perplexity开源两款决策模型：百万输入Token最低1美分，推理最高提速5倍
title.en: Perplexity开源两款决策模型：百万输入Token最低1美分，推理最高提速5倍

current_state.zh: Perplexity open-sourced two multimodal decision models, pplx-decider-v1.2 (27B) and pplx-decider-flash-v1.2 (4B), offering low-cost API access and up to 5x faster batched inference for classification, scoring, and judgment tasks.
